verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly lists Time Tracking as a core feature (clickup-docs-12), supporting logging time against tasks, but the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation on how time is logged against tasks/projects, reporting, or engineer-specific workflows, and community feedback raises general quality concerns about the product (not specific to time tracking). Missing for 10: detailed docs on time-tracking workflow/API, independent hands-on verification of the feature working reliably, project-level time rollups.
